name: Change Readiness Gate
description: Tier 3 (preTaskExecution): Before an Integration/Go-Live task begins, verifies change-management artifacts are in place. Skips silently during earlier phases.

then.prompt:
Check .compliance-state.json → currentPhase. This gate ONLY enforces during the Integration and Go-Live phases. If the project is in Setup, Foundation, Inception or Construction, skip silently.

A task is about to begin. Verify change-readiness before it proceeds. Each numbered check names the rule ID it enforces; log that ID in the event below:

1. CHANGE MANAGEMENT PLAN [CM-001]: A change management plan exists before the Integration phase.
2. STAKEHOLDER MAP [CM-002]: The stakeholder map covers all impacted groups.
3. UAT TRACEABILITY [CM-004]: UAT scenarios trace to requirements.
4. UAT SIGN-OFF [CM-005]: UAT sign-off is recorded per module.
5. TRAINING [CM-006]: Role-based training is complete before go-live.
6. ROLLBACK [CM-010]: Rollback criteria and procedure are documented per module.

Only enforce a rule if its source steering (project-governance.md) actually generated it — a rule absent from .governance/rules/ was intentionally not derived (no steering = no rule) and MUST NOT be treated as a violation. This gate also affirms the current phase's PG-CONST-* and PG-INTEG-* gate obligations where applicable (those rules are owned by phase-gates-generator and referenced here, not re-declared).

Report findings as:
- ✅ Passing rules (silent if all pass)
- ⚠️ Warnings (artifact incomplete)
- ❌ Violations (required artifact missing — resolve before the task proceeds)

If all applicable rules pass, confirm readiness silently.

## Compliance Logging
After completing all checks above, append a JSON event to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` (create the file if it doesn't exist) — ONE event per rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder. Format:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "change-readiness-gate", "trigger": "preTaskExecution", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. CM-001}", "ruleSeverity": "{severity}", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{one-line-finding}"}
Log ONE event per rule checked.
